list_directory.desc: List directory contents with sizes and modification timestamps. Use for detailed file listings when you need timestamps, sizes, or glob-filtered results. For a visual overview of project structure, use directory_tree instead.

params.path: Directory to list. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden entries (names starting with '.'). Default: false.
params.max_depth: Max recursion depth when recursive=true. Default: 3.
params.glob: Only show files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go, *.{ts,tsx}). Applies to files only — directories are always traversed and shown regardless of glob. Default: all files.

create_directory.desc: Create a directory and all missing parents (equivalent to mkdir -p). No-op if the directory already exists.

delete_directory.desc: Delete a directory. IRREVERSIBLE. Must be empty unless force=true — which deletes the entire tree recursively. Confirm with the user before using force=true on directories that may contain important files.

params.force: Delete non-empty directories recursively. IRREVERSIBLE. Default: false.

directory_tree.desc: Print a recursive visual tree of files and directories with sizes. Best for understanding project structure at a glance. For detailed listings with timestamps, use list_directory instead. Use exclude_patterns to skip large irrelevant subtrees (e.g. node_modules, .git, vendor).

params.exclude_patterns: Glob patterns matched against each entry's basename (not full path). "node_modules" excludes any directory with that name at any depth; "*.log" excludes files like error.log.
params.glob: Only show files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go). Default: all files.
